steps.content: Ninety-Nine's illusion falls apart, transforms into a blurred human shape, then turns into foam and vanishes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Phew... I feel much better now. You loser, you can't compare to the real her at all. Ninety-Nine is not that weak.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But I didn't expect they could show up here as well. Are the illusions really that powerful? Or... somehow you're not completely useless?
She lifts her right leg slightly and the red brand emerges faintly on her ankle, the brand of the shackles she's been given.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Humph, never thought a day would come that I'd have to rely on this thing. Take me to that person, then.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That idiot has created so many problems, I have to go and save the day. I must go back!
She swings the pipe, and with a blow, she shatters the illusory realm around her!
